title: Clustering with Fair-Center Representation: Parameterized Approximation Algorithms and Heuristics

problem.claim: The paper studies diversity-aware clustering, where solutions must satisfy representation constraints across facility subsets while optimizing a clustering objective.

contributions.claim: The paper investigates the fixed-parameter tractability of diversity-aware k-median and k-means problems.
The paper establishes negative hardness and inapproximability results for these problems under some parameterizations.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report several negative hardness and inapproximability results, including cases where exponential running time in some parameters is allowed.

narrative_sequence.summary: The work frames diversity-aware clustering as a fairness-oriented variant of classical clustering.
The formulation imposes lower-bound representation requirements on facility subsets while minimizing k-median or k-means objectives.
The paper analyzes fixed-parameter tractability and reports hardness and inapproximability barriers.
